content:
The Mathlib Initiative is happy to announce the documentation overview page is live! This page is intended to contain a complete overview of all documentation helpful for users of Mathlib and of Lean in general. We want it to be as easy as possible to find exactly what you're looking for, from broad reviews of formalized theory to answers to specific technical questions.

Discussion thread: #mathlib4 > Discussion: Mathlib documentation overview

You can help!

The documentation overview is a first version and we'll be working on improving the design and expanding its contents.

If you have ideas for the webpage design and features, please tell us in the discussion thread. We want to make it as easy as possible to sort through all the documentation that exists.

If you write new documentation, or found a page that is not listed yet, please add it to the overview! You can make a pull request to the community website that edits documentation.yaml.

If you are missing documentation on a given topic, please request it on Zulip.
